(Currently Amended)Claim 13 (Previously Presented): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, wherein each contact element has a defined contact surface.

(Currently Amended)Claim 27 (Previously Presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact surface is provided within the second portion and has a structural design that provides clear definitions of electric engagement.

(Currently Amended)Claim 30 (Previously Presented): A connector according to claim 29, wherein said each contact surface is provided within the second portion and has a structural design that ensures engagement with a corresponding contact on the power supply.
